beats.say: 50 years: Ian McKellen knew Patrick Stewart
They met as young actors in the Royal Shakespeare Company and collaborated on several projects.
Ian McKellen led tributes to Patrick Stewart after his death at 86, having also performed with him in Waiting for Godot.
Their collaborations will be remembered for years to come, with fans still enjoying their work in X-Men and theatre.
What is your favourite Ian McKellen and Patrick Stewart collaboration?
Let us know in the comments.

meta.title: Star Stories #10: Ian McKellen 🎭
meta.summary: Sir Ian McKellen and Sir Patrick Stewart first met 50 years ago in the Royal Shakespeare Company. They collaborated on several projects, including the X-Men film franchise and a theatre production of Waiting for Godot.
facts: Sir Ian McKellen first met Sir Patrick Stewart as young actors in the Royal Shakespeare Company half a century ago.
Sir Ian McKellen led tributes to Sir Patrick Stewart following his death at the age of 86
Sir Ian McKellen and Sir Patrick Stewart starred together in the X-Men film franchise
Sir Ian McKellen officiated Sir Patrick Stewart's wedding in 2013.
Sir Ian McKellen and Sir Patrick Stewart starred together in a 2009 theatre production of Waiting for Godot
